parrafo_1.es: Whaat Wash es liderada por Josh, quien lava a presion entradas, terrazas de piscina, lanais, pavers y muelles en Cape Coral y alrededores. Es un servicio movil, sin local fisico: Josh llega directo a tu propiedad.
parrafo_1.en: Whaat Wash is run by Josh, who pressure washes driveways, pool decks, lanais, pavers and docks around Cape Coral. It is a mobile service with no storefront, Josh comes straight to your property.

parrafo_2.es: Sus clientes en Google describen un equipo que trabaja duro, se comunica bien y deja paredes con moho, pavers opacos y terrazas resbalosas luciendo como nuevas.
parrafo_2.en: Clients on Google describe a crew that works hard, communicates well and leaves algae-covered walls, dull pavers and slippery pool decks looking new again.

texto.es: Nos cuentas que necesitas lavar: entrada, terraza de piscina, lanai o muelle.
texto.en: Tell us what needs washing: driveway, pool deck, lanai or dock.

texto.es: Revisamos el espacio y te damos un precio directo antes de empezar.
texto.en: We take a look at the space and give you a straightforward price before we start.

texto.es: Lavamos la superficie a presion, prestando atencion al moho y manchas que otros dejan pasar.
texto.en: We pressure wash the surface, paying attention to the algae and stains others skip.

texto.es: Revisamos el resultado contigo antes de dar el trabajo por terminado.
texto.en: We check the results with you before calling the job done.

nota.es: No hay lista de precios fija, cada trabajo se cotiza segun el espacio. Llamanos y te damos un numero claro.
nota.en: There is no set price list, every job is quoted based on the space. Call us and we will give you a straightforward number.

texto.es: Lavado a presion de entradas, caminos y concreto, el servicio que mas mencionan las reseñas de Whaat Wash en Google.
texto.en: Pressure washing for driveways, walkways and concrete, the service Whaat Wash's Google reviews mention most.

texto.es: Terrazas de piscina, porch pavers y pisos de lanai con malla, limpiados (y pintados o sellados si lo pides).
texto.en: Pool decks, porch pavers and screened lanai floors cleaned, with paint or grit sealing on request.

texto.es: Lavado a presion de muelles y seawalls, quitando moho y acumulacion a la orilla del agua.
texto.en: Pressure washing for docks and seawalls, clearing algae and buildup along the water.

pie.es: No ves lo que buscas? Llamanos igual, lo cotizamos.
pie.en: Do not see what you need? Call us anyway and we will quote it.

items.quote: Wow what a night and day difference! Our lanai and driveway was pressure washed and painted beautifully! He was able to apply the grit + paint onto the pool deck so it's no longer slippery! Very satisfied.

I was blown away at how good the house looked after it had been cleaned. I thought it would look better but if I didn't know better, I would have thought I had new gutters, soffits, garage door, etc. The driveway itself looks phenomenal. I wish I had a “before” picture but this wall was green with algae. It's perfect now!
My driveway was just a mess dirty and dark, Whaat Wash did a real good job, I'm very satisfied with the quality and price.

texto.es: Llamanos, cotizacion clara y trabajo a mano en tu propiedad.
texto.en: Call us, clear quotes and hands-on work right at your property.
